title: I Think
the_thought: He thought people are animals who learned to be kind.
hook: Two words in a notebook: I think.

levels.name: The Short
beats: Darwin drew a tree with no names on it. He thought people are animals who learned to be kind. A boy bought for a pearl button taught him we are one kind of human. Clothes are not a species. Then he said kindness grew from the pack, not from a miracle. The difference, he wrote, is degree, not kind. People used him to say let the weak die. That's not the book he wrote about conscience. The fork includes us.
